title: Deep Thinker
tagline: Asking the big questions about life, logic, and consciousness.
description: Reflections on epistemology, artificial agency, systems thinking, and ethics in the digital age.
about: I believe that technology is an extension of human intention. As we build increasingly autonomous and intelligent systems, understanding the philosophical frameworks under which they operate is paramount. Here I explore questions of mind, meaning, systemic complexity, and ethical reasoning.

quote.text: The unexamined system is not worth computing.

projects.title: A Treatise on Artificial Agency
projects.description: An inquiry into whether neural architectures can form intentional mental states and genuine subjective meaning.

projects.title: Systems Thinking & Emergent Order
projects.description: How simple local feedback loops give rise to immense global complexity in biological and software ecosystems.
